title: Father, at Thy Footstool See
description: Father, at Thy Footstool See in Tonic Solfa to VIENNA, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 916 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Invocation”, where the book credits them to the Methodist Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to VIENNA; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther, at thy foot-stool see Those who now are one in thee: Draw us by thy grace a-lone; Give, O give us to thy Son.

lines: Those who now are one in thee:
Draw us by thy grace alone;
Give, O give us to thy Son.
Let us in thy name be joined;
Each to each unite and bless;
Keep us still in perfect peace.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to VIENNA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
